title: Forge Session
description: A bounded unit of work: one or more agents collaborating on one task. session_id is referenced everywhere (Agent, Event, Command, Context Pack, Result) but this is the object that actually defines what a session is.

workflow_run_id.description: Correlates this session to a specific run of a workflow.schema.json state machine, if the session was started as part of one.

agents.description: IDs of every agent (builder, reviewer, tester...) that participated in this session.

capability_scopes.description: Declared agent capabilities retained with the Session. Declared capabilities are not enforced until the Rule Engine.

summary.description: Short natural-language summary produced at session end, feeding Project Memory. Kept separate from Raw Log/Events, which stay queryable but are never sent as AI context wholesale.
